features.name: Project scaffolding and dependencies
features.description: Create main.py, requirements.txt, and basic app entry point with tkinter window

features.name: Task A UI section
features.description: Enable checkbox and interval input for Task A (press '1')

features.name: Task B UI section
features.description: Enable checkbox, custom text input, and interval input for Task B (type text + Enter)

features.name: Global controls UI
features.description: Play button, Stop button, and real-time status bar

features.name: Multi-threaded task execution
features.description: Task A and Task B run on separate threads with independent intervals

features.name: Anti-collision mutex lock
features.description: Threading lock to prevent keystroke collision between Task A and Task B

features.name: 5-second countdown delay
features.description: Countdown timer before first macro fires after clicking Play

features.name: Global emergency stop hotkey
features.description: F12 or ESC global hotkey to force-stop all threads immediately
